name: Listing copy fact check
summary: The listing agent or marketing lead gets draft listing copy in which every statement is tied to the property sheet, a measurement or a photo, with unsupported descriptions marked and kept out. The listing broker approves; the designated reviewer checks advertising requirements.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of listing and brochure work in real estate; the method was written from how that work is done, with no third-party text.
